title: Apply for a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: Find out what you need and how to apply for a contractor licence if your organisation or partnership plans to carry out residential building or trade work.
intro:
If your organisation or partnership wants to contract, sub-contract and/or advertise to carry out residential building or trade work, you need a contractor licence.

When you apply for a contractor licence you're required to identify a nominated supervisor.

The nominated supervisor must hold an individual contractor licence or qualified supervisor licence, and be:

You can apply for your contractor licence online if you have an Australian Business Number (ABN).

If you do not have an ABN you can submit your application at a service centre if you book an appointment.
who_can_apply: The organisation or partnership must want to contract, sub-contract and/or advertise to carry out residential building or trade work.
The application requires identifying a nominated supervisor who must hold an individual contractor licence or qualified supervisor licence.
what_you_need: A current Australian identity document (such as a driver licence, passport or Medicare card) to verify your identity.
Nominated supervisor details, including licence or certificate number, for each category of work being applied for.
If the company/partnership has a current or expired licence, you will also need the contractor licence number.

faqs.q: Do I need a contractor licence?
faqs.a: Yes, if your organisation or partnership wants to contract, sub-contract and/or advertise to carry out residential building or trade work, you need a contractor licence.

faqs.q: How can I apply for a contractor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply online if you have an Australian Business Number (ABN). If you do not have an ABN, you can submit your application at a service centre if you book an appointment.

faqs.q: What information do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, a current Australian identity document, the company or partnership's ABN, nominated supervisor details, and your fee payment.
